about.title: About Me
about.description: I build reliable, scalable systems and the feedback loops that keep them healthy. My sweet spot is where software, infrastructure as code, and automation meet: Terraform-driven environments, reusable CI/CD pipelines, testing automation, software quality standards, and observability that turns signals into decisions. Recent work spans multi-region migrations, containerized app platforms. I’m cloud-agnostic with a preference for AWS and GCP (Azure-capable when needed). I mentor early-to-mid career engineers, write about practical reliability, and I'm open to senior SRE roles and selective consulting while completing a B.S. in Computer Science.
